findings.label: aggregate-doc-audit
findings.finding: The aggregate stopped at the documentation check expecting 21 ADRs after adding ADR-0022. Updated expected count to 22; did not waive the gate.

findings.label: reviewer-negative-test
findings.finding: The reviewer mutation test initially accepted removal of all inventory records because the loop saw none. Added mandatory global and per-wave inventory counts. The final focused review rejects all 18 required mutations.

findings.label: explicit-request-encoding
findings.finding: Source review found the guest map request used a native u64 array. Stopped only the verified harness and host-check descendants before any guest was active; encoded every map field explicitly as little-endian bytes and restarted final-source acceptance. This interrupted aggregate is not accepted.

findings.label: historical-boundary-reviewer
findings.finding: The aggregate called P3-04 codegen review, which expects 20 pushes/15 pops before P3-05 added a balanced scratch push/pop and CR0.TS guard. The new P3-06 reviewer independently checks the current 21/16 wrapper, CR0 guard, entry/root/copy layout and legacy user instruction obligations. Historical reviewers and evidence are unchanged.
